name: 80-M
description: 80-M, also know as Eightyem, was a protocol droid who served as the interpreter of Jabba Desilijic Tiure, a Hutt crime lord who led his own criminal empire, until he angered his master and was disintegrated. Shortly before the Rescue of Han Solo in 4 ABY, EV-9D9, the supervisor of Jabba's Palace's droid pool, supervised the torture of the old droid when R2-D2 and C-3PO, Jabba's new interpreter, reported to her. EV-9D9 told C-3PO of his predecessor's fate and gestured towards the droid. C-3PO was horrified to witness the droid on a vertical torture rack that stretched its manacled limbs further than they could extend, causing the droid to scream in pain as its arms and legs were slowly pulled off.

data.name: 80-M
data.death: Sometime before the Rescue of Han Solo
